queue.hook: There's an NPC in GTA 6 who knows he's in a video game.
queue.narration: Players found his house on launch day in Belville, in Leonard County. Break into the garage and you'll find his hideout. He's a conspiracy theorist who has figured out the truth. He lives inside a video game. And honestly? He's right. Which makes him the smartest guy in Leonida.
queue.title: This GTA 6 NPC Knows He's in a Video Game

queue.hook: GTA 6 crowds change depending on the neighborhood.
queue.narration: Rockstar confirmed that NPCs look different based on where they live. People in Vice City's Little Cuba look and dress differently from the folks you meet out in the wilderness of Mount Kalaga National Park. So the crowds aren't random. Every area has its own population. Walk around enough and you'll know where you are just by the people.
queue.title: GTA 6 NPCs Aren't Random Anymore
queue.footage: walking through busy Vice City streets

queue.hook: Get stranded at sea in GTA 6 and a dog saves you.
queue.narration: Not a coast guard. A dog. His name is Cool Dog, and he pulls up on a jet ski to rescue you. Players even say he can take you to Dog Island. There's no deeper meaning here. It's a dog driving a jet ski. And that's everything you need to know.
queue.title: GTA 6 Has a Dog That Drives a Jet Ski
queue.footage: floating in open ocean, jet ski riding

queue.hook: GTA 6 has a secret radio station you unlock with your phone.
queue.narration: Go to The Vault nightclub in Downtown Vice City, south of the Jack of Hearts and west of NINE1NINE. Just inside the entrance, there's a red poster. Scan it with WAiNK, your in-game phone, and the secret station unlocks. Scan four more posters and you get another hidden playlist, The Sniper of La Perle. Free music for snooping.
queue.title: GTA 6 Hides a Secret Radio Station
queue.footage: driving through Downtown Vice City at night
